liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Rain** (3 reviews): Rain is described as a powerful version and the heart of the show, alongside Saint of Circumstance and Space into The Wheel; During Rain it was both sunny and raining, a warm summer sun shower that delighted the wet crowd [4][6][8]

## The recordings

- **gd94-06-17.nak700.ladner.9774.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 4.37/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: From up front for the post-drums portion, the sound was among the best the reviewer had ever heard [11]
- **gd1994-06-17.145696.senn441.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 164 min [3]
- **gd1994-06-17.neumann.unknown.larson.28898.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 2.5/5 by 4 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls a camping scene and a country fair at the venue, with rain falling on the day [4]
- Rain fell for a while but not all show; during the break, fans made a slip and slide on the tarp-covered grass [5]
- The band had difficulties getting the second set started; the show started slow and improved as it went [5]
- Reviewer heard soundcheck of Lucy in the Sky, Samba in the Rain and another song on the morning of the first show [7]
- A sunshower occurred; a pirate ship was seen sailing around the lots, and early start times left room to party afterward [7]
- Eugene welcomed deadheads, camping was right outside the stadium, and the rain during the show added energy [9]
- OJ and Al Cowlins were reportedly doing the Bronco Boogie during the show [11]
- Rain kept away many weekend warriors; Dead Set skeletons and a large Aiko eye decoration were displayed on the stadium's outside [14]
- Reviewer rates the music as pretty good by 1994 standards [11]
- Reviewer says you can't beat Eugene for a show, citing the city's welcome to deadheads [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-06-17.nak700.ladner.9774.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul B.; source: Audience: Nakamichi 700's [1]. Also: Audience recording on Nak700 microphones, transferred to DAT then CDR, via Paul B; seeded to etree by neolevo/candyman [1]
- **gd1994-06-17.145696.senn441.flac1648**: taped by John Anastas; source: Sennheiser 441 > DAT > patch DAT [3]. Also: Patch tape master from John Anastas's collection, from an unknown source DAT deck and patch deck; new to circulation [3]
- **gd1994-06-17.neumann.unknown.larson.28898.shnf**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: Nuemann mics (model number unknown)>DAT [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead RARE 6/17/1994 Autzen Stadium Eugene Backstage Pass - Reonegro Art | #1884706062](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-17-1994-autzen-stadium-1884706062) [17]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-06-17 Autzen Stadium, U. of Oregon, Eugene, OR, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-06-17-autzen-stadium-u-of-oregon-eugene-or-usa/) [18]
- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead Autzen Stadium 1994 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/gd-1994-autzen-4355) [19]
